event_text: ShinyHunters claims a breach of the FBI jobs site; the FBI says it is investigating the claims, per BleepingComputer
An FBI cyber official says a contractor's missed security patch caused the jobs-site breach, per NBC News
White House release quotes the DNI and Secretary of State: the week's tech outages were not a cyberattack
FBI officials know of the NCIC intrusion by this day, per CNN's two sources
notes: CNN does not give an exact discovery date.

event_text: CNN reports the FBI is investigating an apparent NCIC intrusion; the FBI does not respond to a request for comment
NBC News reports, citing two people briefed on the matter, that the FBI is investigating an apparent NCIC breach; the FBI has no comment
AP reports, citing a person familiar with the matter, that the FBI is investigating an apparent NCIC hack; the FBI declines to comment
notes: AP article date; publication time not retrieved.

event_text: the President, asked on Fox News about the reports, calls the NCIC hack 'not good' without giving details
notes: Axios says Saturday morning; The Hill story is stamped 2:36 PM ET.

event_text: ABC News reports a law enforcement source confirmed to it that the database was hacked; the FBI does not respond to ABC
the DNI, on ABC's This Week and Fox News Sunday, says the FBI 'has an incident' it is handling, and declines to give specifics
Nextgov/FCW reports, citing an unnamed law enforcement representative, that police agencies using NCIC have not been formally told about the intrusion by the FBI
At a Justice Department press conference, the FBI Director, asked about the NCIC hack, says the matter is an ongoing investigation and declines to say who did it or what was taken
notes: Reuters livestream of the press conference; CyberScoop report.
